payload.core_mechanism_summary: 2D DP with state (i,j) representing max similarity score for substrings ending at positions i and j, using recurrence with +2 on match and -1 penalty otherwise.
payload.rationale: The solution explicitly builds an (m+1)x(n+1) DP table and iterates over both string indices, computing L[i][j] from L[i-1][j-1], L[i-1][j], L[i][j-1]. This is a classic 2-dimensional DP state.
